question: How does absorption become clear in relation to the paths and the body?
premises: The whole aggregate of paths has already been determined as situated in the body.
That same reality unfolds from within.
By the force of its unfolding, absorption may become clear.
inference: Absorption becomes explicit when the path-structure already present in the body unfolds from within.
plain_english: Moreover, this whole aggregate of paths has already been determined as present in the body; by the force of its unfolding, absorption may become clear.
